papers.title_en: An explainable machine learning model based on quantitative HRCT parameters for identifying bronchoscopically confirmed airway stenosis in tracheobronchial tuberculosis.
papers.authors: Jia B, He G, Yao Y, Yan G, Li B, Zhu M, Luo X, Zhang A et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Suining Central Hospital, Suining, 629000, Sichuan, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: XGBoost模型展示了卓越的准确性、校准度和可解释性，为TBTB管理中气道狭窄的个体化风险评估提供了一个有前景的工具。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告任何AUC/准确率的95%CI或P值、未给出校准与决策曲线的具体数值，也未说明训练/验证集划分比例与样本量分配，难以判断过拟合风险；为单中心回顾性数据，缺乏外部或时间外验证，AUC 0.935可能偏乐观；未提及类别不平衡处理（气道狭窄发生率未给出），特异度0.980与敏感度0.805的组合提示阈值选择可能影响表现；SHAP影像学预测因子（T/D比值）与狭窄的因果方向未在摘要中说明；摘要称‘promising tool’但无前瞻性或影响临床决策的验证证据。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Airway stenosis is a frequent and serious complication of tracheobronchial tuberculosis (TBTB), leading to chronic airflow obstruction and reduced quality of life. However, no individualized predictive model currently exists to assess airway narrowing risk in these patients. METHODS: This retrospective study included 476 patients with TBTB admitted to Suining Central Hospital between January 2017 and July 2024. Demographic, clinical, and quantitative imaging features were analyzed using seven machine learning algorithms. Model training employed repeated cross-validation with grid search for hyperparameter optimization. Model performance was evaluated by discrimination, calibration, and clinical utility, and Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) were used for interpretation. RESULTS: The XGBoost model achieved the best overall performance, with an AUC of 0.935, accuracy of 0.930, sensitivity of 0.805, specificity of 0.980. SHAP analysis revealed that the mean T/D ratio and the T/D ratios of the right superior lobar bronchus, right middle lobar bronchus, and left superior lobar bronchus were the most influential imaging predictors, while female sex and symptom duration more than 4 weeks were significant clinical risk factors. CONCLUSION: The XGBoost model demonstrated superior accuracy, calibration, and interpretability, providing a promising tool for individualized risk assessment airway stenosis in TBTB management.

papers.title_en: The role of 18F-FDG PET-CT in predicting progressive pulmonary fibrosis in idiopathic inflammatory myopathy associated interstitial lung disease.
papers.authors: Sun C, Zhang Z, Zhao Q, Huang L, Tian J, Wu W, Li Y, Teng J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of General Medicine/Internal Medicine, Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, School of Medicine, Sh…
papers.authors_conclusion: 18F-FDG PET-CT与FVC%pred与PPF的发生相关；PPF预后差，高SUVmax与短期死亡相关。该列线图表现出稳健的区分度与校准度，具有临床应用潜力。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告logistic回归各变量的OR值及95%CI、未报告事件/变量比，29个事件支撑的多因素模型存在过拟合风险，且仅有内部验证、无外部验证队列。Hosmer-Lemeshow P=0.143在小样本下检验效能有限，被表述为'excellent agreement'有过度解读之嫌。生存比较仅给P值，未报告HR、中位生存或删失情况。SUVmax组间比较仅报P值，缺效应量与截断值。属关联性观察结果，作者结论口径与'associated with'一致但'holds potential for clinical application'超出当前证据强度。
papers.abstract_en: AIM: This study aims to investigate the role of 18F-FDG PET-CT in the development of progressive pulmonary fibrosis (PPF) in patients with idiopathic inflammatory myopathy-associated interstitial lung disease (IIM-ILD) and to develop a predictive nomogram model. METHODS: This study retrospectively included patients diagnosed with IIM-ILD who underwent 18F-FDG PET-CT at Ruijin Hospital between 2018 and 2024. The baseline characteristics, IIM types, myositis antibodies, laboratory tests, pulmonary function, ILD subtypes, 18F-FDG PET-CT findings, and treatment were collected. Enrolled patients were divided into PPF and non-PPF groups according to diagnostic criteria. Clinical features were compared between the two groups, and logistic regression analysis was performed to identify risk factors for PPF. All identified risk factors were combined to construct the predictive nomogram. Receiver operating characteristic curve, calibration plot, and decision curve analysis were used to evaluate the accuracy and efficiency of this predictive model. Additionally, we drew the survival curve of PPF and non-PPF, and compared the maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) between short-term death and long-term survival. RESULTS: A total of 71 eligible IIM-ILD patients were included, of whom 29 developed PPF within one year of follow-up. Multivariate analysis revealed that bilateral lung SUVmax and FVC%pred were associated with the occurrence of PPF. The calibration plot demonstrated excellent agreement between the predicted and actual observed probability of PPF (Hosmer-Lemeshow test: P = 0.143). The predictive nomogram achieved an area under the curve of 0.887 (95% CI: 0.805-0.969). The SUVmax in the lungs was significantly higher in the PPF group than in the non-PPF group (P < 0.001). Moreover, lung SUVmax was significantly higher in patients who died within one year than in those who survived for more than five years (P = 0.014). In addition, patients with PPF had a significantly lower survival rate than those without PPF (P = 0.040). CONCLUSION: 18F-FDG PET-CT and FVC% pred are associated with the occurrence of PPF. The prognosis of PPF is poor, and high SUVmax is correlated with short-term mortality. Exhibiting robust discrimination and calibration, this nomogram holds potential for clinical application.

papers.study_type: 多组学整合+孟德尔随机化+单细胞分析+体外药理学的转化前研究
papers.title_zh: 多组学与药理学分析将DDX60确定为EGCG在食管鳞癌中的候选作用靶点（体外与计算证据）
papers.title_en: Multi-omics and pharmacological analyses identify DDX60 as a candidate EGCG-engaged target in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
papers.authors: Zhu H, Ainiwa A, Zhang YH, Lv GH, Zhao LT, Abuduwaili A, Chen HY, Jing XL et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, First Affiliated Hospital of Xinjiang Medical University, Urumqi, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: Conclusively, DDX60 demonstrated considerable potential as an exploitable target in ESCC, amenable to modulation by EGCG through the disruption of DDX60-associated oncogenic mechanisms.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告MR效应值、CI或P值，也未给出细胞实验的定量数据与统计检验，无法评估效应大小与显著性。EGCG相关证据主要来自体外（CETSA、细胞活力、敲减后敏感性差异），无动物或患者层面验证；PheWAS/DSigDB筛选与分子对接仅提示相关性，不能证明EGCG直接作用于DDX60。单细胞部分仅描述性关联（EMT、干扰素反应、PI3K/AKT/mTOR评分略升高），与功能实验的因果链未在摘要中闭合。将MR（食管癌泛癌种）结果外推至ESCC靶点存在人群限定松动问题。
papers.abstract_en: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is highly aggressive with limited available biomarkers, and discovering causative, functionally significant, and pharmacologically tractable targets is fundamental for new intervention strategies. By integrating Mendelian randomization, multi-cohort transcriptomic validation, single-cell analysis, and experimental pharmacology, DDX60 was identified as a key candidate gene associated with ESCC. The two-sample MR integrating eQTLGen, IEU OpenGWAS, and FinnGen datasets identified DDX60 as a key gene associated with esophageal cancer. Multi-omics utilizing TCGA, GTEx, cfDNA 5hmC profiling, and paired clinical ESCC specimens validated DDX60 expression in ESCC. Single-cell RNA-seq showed DDX60 enrichment in tumor-derived malignant epithelial cells versus matched normal epithelium. Epithelial cells expressing high DDX60 displayed enhanced epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and interferon-response signatures, accompanied by a slightly elevated PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway score and progression along the malignant epithelial trajectory. Functionally, silencing DDX60 in ESCC cells increased apoptosis, decreased the phosphorylation of PI3K, AKT, and mTOR, and inhibited migration and invasion. These results demonstrated the role of DDX60 in ESCC progression. To explore potential pharmacological modulation of DDX60, PheWAS- and DSigDB-guided compound screening, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation were performed, identifying epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) as a candidate DDX60-associated compound. EGCG reduced ESCC cell viability, decreased the levels of DDX60 protein, and enhanced the thermal stability of endogenous DDX60 in cell-based CETSA assays. Analysis using DDX60-knockdown cells further suggested that DDX60 status may influence cellular responsiveness to EGCG. Conclusively, DDX60 demonstrated considerable potential as an exploitable target in ESCC, amenable to modulation by EGCG through the disruption of DDX60-associated oncogenic mechanisms.

papers.title_en: Targeting Pseudomonas aeruginosa ventilator-associated pneumonia with a non-antibiotic and biofilm-disrupting live biotherapeutic: preclinical safety and efficacy study.
papers.authors: Fernández-Barat L, Motos A, Segura-Morales C, Kiarostami K, Cabrera R, Soler-Comas A, Broto A, Mazzolini R et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: CELLEX Research Laboratories, CIBERES (Centro de Investigación Biomédica en Red de Enfermedades Respiratorias, 06/06/002…
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings suggest CV8_VAP as a promising, non-antibiotic therapeutic strategy for treating VAP caused by P. aeruginosa.
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告任何样本量、效应量与统计学数值（P值/CI全缺），'reduced'、'markedly decreased'、'enhanced efficacy'均为定性表述，无法判断效应大小与显著性；雾化优于注射的结论无数据支撑；Shannon多样性'statistically comparable'可能仅为未拒绝差异，非等效性设计；1例雾化给药动物死于疑似过敏样反应，动物安全性外推至人证据不足；临床前猪模型结果，信息不足
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The endotracheal tube (ETT) compromises the host's bronchial defences and facilitates the formation of microbial biofilms and Ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP). Although antibiotics remain the cornerstone treatment, their efficacy is often compromised by poor biofilm penetration and the prevalence of multidrug-resistant bacteria. This reveals the need to develop novel non-antibiotic therapeutic strategies. We previously engineered a non-pathogenic strain of the pulmonary bacteria Mycoplasma pneumoniae (CV2) to express anti-biofilm and bactericidal enzymes (VAP platform). METHODS: We evaluated the safety of an improved version of CV2 (CV8, Mycochassis) in a miniature pig model, and its efficacy with the VAP platform (CV8_VAP) in a piglet model of Pseudomonas aeruginosa-induced VAP. CV8_VAP was administered via intralobe instillation or nebulisation. We assessed the platform's ability to degrade biofilms formed on ETTs in vivo and its impact on the airway microbiota. We evaluated bacterial load in the lungs, inflammatory responses, histopathological and clinical outcomes. Statistics included t-tests, ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis, Mann-Whitney U and mixed-effects rank-based methods. FINDINGS: VAP platform reduced ETT biofilm thickness and P. aeruginosa load in lungs, with the nebulised route showing enhanced efficacy. Shannon diversity remained statistically comparable across groups in both ETTs and lung tissue. Inflammatory markers in the lung were markedly decreased, suggesting a local immunomodulatory effect. One animal receiving nebulised CV8_VAP died from a suspected anaphylactic-like reaction; no other serious adverse events were attributable to treatment. INTERPRETATION: These findings suggest CV8_VAP as a promising, non-antibiotic therapeutic strategy for treating VAP caused by P. aeruginosa. FUNDING: "La Caixa" Foundation, and the European Research Council under the European Union's Horizon 2020 research and innovation program.

papers.title_zh: Selective Retrieval Routing for Finding-Oriented Chest Radiograph Text Generation: A Locked Policy Evaluation.
papers.title_en: Selective Retrieval Routing for Finding-Oriented Chest Radiograph Text Generation: A Locked Policy Evaluation.
papers.authors: Sun Y, Chen Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Electronics and Information Engineering, Sichuan University, Wangjiang Campus, No.
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation is increasingly used in medical text systems, but its value may depend on when it is activated. We evaluated retrieval as a case-level routing decision for finding-oriented chest radiograph text generation. Five policies were compared using a frozen visual generator, the official PadChest-GR split (3185 training, 455 validation, and 915 test studies), and a locked evaluation pipeline. The primary outcome was six-label clinical F1. Retrieval burden was quantified as the mean number of retrieved neighbors per study, and the Lexical Overlap Index measured surface overlap. Sensitivity analyses included 1000 matched random gates and an exploratory blinded review of 100 cases by three reviewers. Six-label clinical F1 was 0.3488 with No Retrieval and 0.2670 with Always Retrieval. Risk-only top 60% achieved the highest observed value among the evaluated policies (0.3703), with a paired-bootstrap difference of + 0.02157 (95% CI, 0.01707 to 0.02654) versus No Retrieval. Matched random routing achieved 0.3020 ± 0.0053, and no seed reached the Risk-only result. In blinded review, Always Retrieval produced fewer reviewer-assessed acceptable outputs and more unsupported findings than No Retrieval. Risk-only routing did not show a clear acceptability advantage over No Retrieval and had a directionally higher unsupported-finding proportion. These findings indicate that automatic metric gains should be interpreted separately from demonstrated clinical quality.

papers.title_zh: Prospective field deployment of Swaasa® AI for community-based screening of tuberculosis and other respiratory diseases in Andhra Pradesh: a feasibility and implementation study.
papers.title_en: Prospective field deployment of Swaasa® AI for community-based screening of tuberculosis and other respiratory diseases in Andhra Pradesh: a feasibility and implementation study.
papers.authors: Nammi V, Rao Sripada N, De P, Palreddy SD, Pullae SRM
papers.affiliation_highlight: Medical and Health and Family Welfare Department District Leprosy, AIDS and TB Control Office, East Godavari District, A…
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a major public health problem in India. In the state of Andhra Pradesh (AP), the burden of TB is compounded by a shortage of specialists and the lack of scalable, real-time community screening tools. We prospectively implemented Swaasa® AI, a software as a medical device (SaMD) product, in a real-world community healthcare setting and evaluated its feasibility and user experience for TB screening, with the additional capability to identify individuals at potential risk of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and asthma. Swaasa® uses machine learning (ML) algorithms to analyze acoustic cough patterns and gather information through guided questions about symptoms. Unlike conventional TB screening, which primarily targets symptomatic individuals, Swaasa® supports symptom-agnostic community screening. METHODS: The platform was deployed in a pilot screening program and integrated into existing healthcare workflows. Trained frontline health workers collected cough recordings using smartphones, and the platform generated automated risk assessments for TB, COPD, and asthma. Over a 6-week deployment, a total of 7,879 individuals from vulnerable populations were screened. Based on risk stratification (Green, Amber, and Red) from Swaasa®, high-risk individuals were referred for confirmatory testing, specifically using nucleic acid amplification tests (NAATs) for TB and spirometry for COPD and asthma. RESULTS: Swaasa® AI identified 780 individuals (~10%) at risk of TB and referred them for confirmatory testing. TB was confirmed in 11 of these individuals, yielding an observed TB yield of 1.41% (11/780). Among symptomatic Swaasa®-positive individuals, 7 of 23 were diagnosed with TB, corresponding to an observed yield of 30.4%. Importantly, 36% of the identified TB cases were asymptomatic. In addition to TB, the platform identified that 6.5-9.5% of the population was at risk of COPD and 1.6-1.9% at risk of asthma. Further evaluation using spirometry as part of the clinical assessment for COPD and asthma showed that 95% of high-risk individuals identified by Swaasa® had abnormal findings. The study also demonstrated an excellent system usability score (80 to 93%) and a very high perceived usefulness rating (4.37-5) for the use of Swaasa®. CONCLUSION: This SaMD model offers a scalable pathway for early identification of respiratory diseases, particularly in populations with limited access to specialist care.

papers.title_zh: Development, internal validation, and independent external evaluation of a nomogram for pulmonary embolism risk in hospitalized patients.
papers.title_en: Development, internal validation, and independent external evaluation of a nomogram for pulmonary embolism risk in hospitalized patients.
papers.authors: Wu HH, Shi QQ, Chen S, Wei Q, Lv YX, Lv Z
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory medicine, Dongyang Hospital affiliated to Wenzhou Medical University, Dongyang, 322100, Zhejia…
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: To develop and internally validate a nomogram for pulmonary embolism (PE) risk in hospitalized patients and to evaluate its performance in an independent hospital cohort. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 4,380 eligible inpatients from Dongyang Hospital Affiliated to Wenzhou Medical University. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression was followed by multivariable logistic regression with backward Akaike information criterion selection, and the cohort was randomly divided 70:30 for development and internal validation. Independent evaluation used 1,376 CTPA-evaluable first admissions from the First Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University. The locked original intercept and unrounded coefficients were applied without refitting, and 95% confidence intervals were obtained using 2,000 stratified bootstrap resamples. RESULTS: The development cohort included 233 patients with PE and 2,833 without PE, and the internal validation cohort included 104 patients with PE and 1,210 without PE. Thirteen predictors were retained in the nomogram. The AUC was 0.767 (95% CI, 0.735-0.799) in development and 0.808 (95% CI, 0.766-0.850) in internal validation. The independent cohort comprised 519 patients with PE and 857 without PE; the locked model yielded an AUC of 0.720 (95% bootstrap CI, 0.691-0.746). The Brier score was 0.222 (95% bootstrap CI, 0.211-0.232), with a calibration intercept of 0.339 and slope of 0.606. CONCLUSIONS: The nomogram retained moderate discrimination in an independent hospital cohort. Application of the locked original equation quantified systematic risk underestimation and identified higher net benefit than the treat-all and treat-none strategies across threshold probabilities of approximately 25%-65%. These findings support transportability while indicating the need for local recalibration and prospective comparison with established diagnostic pathways.

papers.authors: Shaw N, Peckham DG, Kellar I, Rousseau N, Bourke SJ, Anderson A, Faisal M, Alldred DP et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Healthcare, Faculty of Medicine, University of Leeds, UK; Adult Cystic Fibrosis Unit, Leeds Teaching Hospitals…
papers.authors_conclusion: 尽管引入了CFTR调节剂治疗，用药相关负担仍普遍存在；更大负担与多重用药、需要支持及社会经济因素相关；LMQ-3或可作为筛查工具，识别需要针对性干预以降低治疗负担的个体
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未说明高负担相关因素是否经多因素校正，也未报告关联的效应量、CI或P值；横断面设计无法确立因果方向（如失业与高负担孰先孰后）；自报肺功能（ppFEV₁%）存在测量偏倚；60%应答率可能存在非应答偏倚；研究无未用CFTRm者或一般人群对照，'负担仍普遍存在'缺乏与调节剂前时代的基线比较，属无对照的绝对水平陈述
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: While CFTR modulators (CFTRm) have transformed clinical outcomes in CF, their impact on perceived medicines-related burden is not fully understood. This study aimed to quantify medicines-related burden in adults with CF prescribed CFTRm. METHODS: A cross-sectional survey was conducted between September and December 2022 in two adult CF centres in the North of England. Subjects >16 years and receiving CFTR modulator therapy were recruited in both inpatient and outpatient settings. Medicines-related burden was assessed using the validated Living with Medicines Questionnaire version 3 (LMQ-3). Data on use of pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy (PERT), insulin, number of daily medicines, and self-reported lung function (ppFEV₁%) was also captured. RESULTS: Of 577 eligible participants, 346 completed the survey (60%). The mean (SD) age was 33.6 (±12) years, with 190 (54.9%) male. The mean LMQ-3 score was 83.01 (SD 18.8; range 42-127). Minimal, moderate and high burden was experienced in 58.4%, 32.9% and 8.7% of subjects respectively. Higher burden was significantly associated with receiving help in managing medicines, greater number of daily medicines, lower educational attainment, and unemployment. No significant associations were observed for age, sex, lung function, pancreatic or diabetic status. CONCLUSION: Despite the introduction of CFTRm therapy, medicines-related burden remains prevalent. Greater burden is associated with polypharmacy, need for support, and socioeconomic factors. The LMQ-3 may be a useful screening tool to identify individuals requiring targeted interventions to reduce treatment burden.

papers.title_en: The hypoxia, lactate and lactylation axis in lung disease: A metabolic and epigenetic framework.
papers.authors: Wu M, Xu W, Zhu Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: The Second Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Jiangsu Second Hospital of Traditi…
papers.authors_conclusion: The framework therefore provides a basis for testing how oxygen stress influences pulmonary pathology rather than evidence for a uniformly established causal pathway or a clinically validated therapeutic class.
papers.ai_note: 该文为框架/叙述性综述，摘要未报告检索策略、纳入标准与证据分级方法的预设流程，方法学透明度信息不足；作者自身强调'观察到的代谢序列'与'特定乳酰化事件介导疾病'的证明之间存在显著缺口，且直接核酸乳酰化尚未被验证、现有干预剂常改变代谢或其他蛋白酰化——即结论明确限定了证据强度，读取时不应外推为已确立的因果通路或可成药治疗类别；无可报告的效应量数值。
papers.abstract_en: Hypoxia accompanies diverse pulmonary diseases and can promote glycolytic reprogramming and lactate accumulation. Lactate serves as a metabolic fuel and signalling molecule and can supply substrates for protein lysine lactylation. These activities are related but experimentally distinct. Here, we evaluate a hypoxia, lactate and lactylation framework across pulmonary hypertension, lung cancer, pulmonary fibrosis, acute lung injury, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and asthma. We distinguish studies that manipulate oxygen availability and measure downstream metabolic and lactylation responses from those that demonstrate lactate signalling or lactylation without establishing hypoxia as the initiating event. We assess evidence for individual mechanisms according to human validation, biochemical resolution and the specificity of in vivo interventions. This comparison identifies substantial gaps between an observed metabolic sequence and proof that a particular lactylation event mediates disease. We also examine how protein lactylation intersects with RNA-modifying enzymes and DNA-repair machinery, while recognizing that direct nucleic-acid lactylation remains unvalidated. Potential interventions range from lactate production and transport to lactylation regulators, but current agents frequently alter metabolism or other protein acylations. The framework therefore provides a basis for testing how oxygen stress influences pulmonary pathology rather than evidence for a uniformly established causal pathway or a clinically validated therapeutic class.

papers.title_zh: 综述：以心脏-免疫微环境框架整合多种新型抗肿瘤疗法的心血管毒性机制，属概念性框架而非经临床验证的证据
papers.title_en: Is the cardio-immune microenvironment a convergent hub of cardiovascular toxicity across novel anticancer therapies?
papers.authors: Quan Y, Lang C, Xie P, Zhang Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiology, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: This context-dependent framework may help clarify why distinct anticancer therapies can produce overlapping cardiovascular phenotypes while preserving therapy-specific mechanisms and clinical management priorities.
papers.ai_note: 纯概念性综述，无原始数据、无纳入/排除标准或系统检索流程；'机制性趋同'与五个机制域为作者自定框架，未给出任何验证性数值或证据分级；对风险分层、生物标志物、影像监测的潜在价值均为推测性表述（may inform），信息不足，无法评估其实际临床效用。
papers.abstract_en: Novel anticancer therapies have transformed oncology but have also expanded the spectrum of cancer therapy-related cardiovascular toxicity, including myocarditis, ventricular dysfunction, hypertension, vascular inflammation, thrombosis, arrhythmias, fibrosis, and heart failure. In cardio-oncology, the cardio-immune microenvironment provides a useful framework for integrating cardiovascular toxicity across immune checkpoint inhibitors, CAR-T cell therapy and other T-cell-redirecting therapies, HER2-directed therapies, VEGF/VEGFR inhibitors, antibody-drug conjugates, radiotherapy-containing regimens, and combination treatments. This Review discusses the cardio- immune microenvironment as a tissue-level network in which immune cells, cardiomyocytes, endothelial cells, vascular cells, fibroblasts, soluble mediators, and extracellular-matrix cues interact during injury and repair. Rather than proposing a universal immune origin for all cardiotoxic effects, we distinguish three routes by which novel anticancer treatments may enter this network: immune initiation, systemic inflammatory translation, and primary cardiomyocyte, endothelial, vascular, or payload-related injury followed by immune amplification and remodeling. We define mechanistically meaningful convergence as engagement of a shared downstream cellular-molecular response module by therapies with distinct proximal mechanisms, while distinguishing such convergence from nonspecific injury-repair responses. We organize the cardio-immune framework around five mechanistic domains: immune tolerance breakdown, cytokine-driven systemic inflammation, sterile danger sensing, myeloid and stromal reprogramming, and endothelial-immune coupling. We further discuss how these mechanisms may inform therapy-specific risk stratification, biomarker interpretation, imaging surveillance, mechanism-guided intervention, and multi-omics approaches in precision cardio-oncology. This context-dependent framework may help clarify why distinct anticancer therapies can produce overlapping cardiovascular phenotypes while preserving therapy-specific mechanisms and clinical management priorities.

papers.title_zh: Shock index and modified shock index at initial clinical assessment in adults with dengue from Oaxaca, Mexico: sex-based differences in a cross-sectional study.
papers.title_en: Shock index and modified shock index at initial clinical assessment in adults with dengue from Oaxaca, Mexico: sex-based differences in a cross-sectional study.
papers.authors: Martínez Guerra M, Hernández-Huerta MT, Pérez-Campos E, Guerra Martínez A, Elizarrarás-Rivas J, Pérez-Campos Mayoral L, Jarquín González EE, Cabrera Fuentes HA et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Facultad de Medicina y Cirugía, Universidad Autónoma "Benito Juárez" de Oaxaca, Oaxaca, Mexico.
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Dengue-associated plasma leakage and compensatory hemodynamic changes may precede overt hypotension. Evidence on shock index (SI) and modified shock index (MSI) distributions and sex-based differences in adults with dengue remains limited. This study aimed to describe SI and MSI at the initial recorded clinical assessment and compare these indices between women and men. Secondary exploratory analyses examined clinical, laboratory, inflammatory, and immunonutritional variables. METHODS: This cross-sectional observational study included 121 adults with dengue from Oaxaca, Mexico. SI was calculated as heart rate divided by systolic blood pressure, and MSI as heart rate divided by mean arterial pressure. Continuous variables were compared using Welch's unpaired t-test or the Mann-Whitney U test, as appropriate; categorical variables were compared using Fisher's exact test. Analyses were descriptive and exploratory. RESULTS: Participants included 69 women and 52 men; median age was 29.0 years (IQR, 21.0-45.5). Overall median SI was 0.957 (IQR, 0.801-1.137), and mean MSI was 1.257 ± 0.290. Women had higher SI [1.000 (0.811-1.221) versus 0.889 (0.794-1.000); p = 0.0122] and MSI (1.318 ± 0.319 versus 1.176 ± 0.225), with a mean MSI difference of 0.142 (95% CI, 0.044-0.240; p = 0.0049). Women had higher heart rate, whereas blood pressure measurements did not differ significantly. The neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and systemic immune-inflammation index did not differ significantly by sex. The prognostic nutritional index was lower in women [44.05 (38.43-47.30) versus 47.60 (43.14-53.25); p = 0.0007]. DISCUSSION: SI and MSI were higher in women than in men. These differences coincided with higher heart rate, whereas blood pressure measurements did not differ significantly between sexes. Because we did not assess disease severity, diagnostic performance, or longitudinal outcomes, these unadjusted findings are exploratory and require prospective validation before clinical thresholds or prognostic implications can be established.

papers.ai_note: 研究仅依赖ICD-10住院编码识别POPH（同时含1组PAH与门脉高压编码），存在误分类风险，且无疾病严重程度校正（如NYHA分级、血流动力学、MELD评分）；仅纳入住院期间数据，无法评估长期预后的种族/性别差异；唯一阳性结果为住院费用这一资源利用指标而非临床终点，摘要将费用差异作为主要发现呈现而主要临床终点均为阴性；与既往注册研究结论相悖的原因可能是人群与方法学差异（住院声称数据 vs 专科注册库），摘要未充分讨论
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Portopulmonary hypertension (POPH) carries a poor prognosis, yet the influence of gender and race on inpatient outcomes is not well defined. Prior registry data suggested that POPH occurred more frequently in Hispanic patients and was associated with higher all-cause mortality. We examined whether gender and race were associated with inpatient outcomes in POPH hospitalizations. METHODS: We analyzed the 2017-2019 National Inpatient Sample. Adult hospitalizations carrying concurrent Group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension and portal hypertension codes were identified using the International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision. Multivariable logistic and linear regression models estimated the independent association of gender and race with in-hospital mortality, length of stay, total hospital charges, shock, and sepsis. RESULTS: We identified a weighted total of 36,090 POPH hospitalizations. After multivariable adjustment, neither gender nor race was independently associated with in-hospital mortality, length of stay, shock, or sepsis. The only significant disparity was in total hospital charges, which were higher among Hispanic than White patients (adjusted difference $17,585; 95% CI $2015-$33,155; p = 0.027). CONCLUSIONS: In this contemporary national cohort, gender and race were not independently associated with in-hospital mortality or major complications in POPH, in contrast to prior reports. The higher hospital charges observed for Hispanic patients, in the absence of differences in clinical outcomes, warrant further study of resource utilization and access to care.

papers.title_zh: 综述HIV通过病毒蛋白与ART药物抑制免疫细胞自噬、从而促进结核易感性的机制框架，并提出自噬作为宿主导向治疗靶点
papers.title_en: HIV-induced autophagy suppression in tuberculosis pathogenesis: from mechanisms to therapeutic implications.
papers.authors: Xia C, Fan X, Cheng F, Yang S, Zhang X, Chen Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Biobank, Clinical Research Center, Chongqing Public Health Medical Center, Chongqing, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: 作者提出将HIV驱动的自噬抑制与结核易感性增强相联系的整合性机制框架，强调HIV蛋白与Mtb免疫逃逸策略的协同作用；并认为自噬是一个有前景的治疗靶点，自噬导向的宿主导向疗法有潜力降低PLWH中持续存在的结核负担，并推动两种感染的治愈。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未说明文献检索策略、纳入排除标准与证据分级，机制链条多以'可能（may）'表述，属假说性综合而非系统评价；16–27倍与4–7倍的风险数据在摘要中未标注出处、人群或CI，无法核验；从体外/动物机制直接外推至'宿主导向治疗可降低结核负担并推进治愈'，缺乏人体干预证据支持，结论存在乐观外推倾向。
papers.abstract_en: Tuberculosis (TB) remains the leading cause of death among people living with HIV (PLWH) despite effective antiretroviral therapy (ART), with HIV infection increasing the risk of active TB by 16 to 27-fold. Even among virologically suppressed individuals on ART, the risk remains 4 to 7-fold higher than in HIV-negative populations, indicating that mechanisms beyond CD4+ T-cell depletion contribute to persistent TB susceptibility. Autophagy is a conserved lysosomal degradation pathway essential for intracellular pathogen clearance and immune regulation, and its dysregulation has emerged as a critical determinant of host-pathogen interactions in HIV/TB co-infection. In this review, we synthesize current evidence suggesting that HIV profoundly suppresses autophagy in key immune cells through the concerted actions of viral proteins, including Nef, Tat, and Env, through the off-target effects of ART drugs. This inhibition may disrupt macrophage antimicrobial functions, including phagosome maturation, xenophagy, and LC3-associated phagocytosis, while also impairing antigen presentation in dendritic cells. These defects may compromise communication between immune cells, attenuate T-cell responses, and create a permissive intracellular niche for Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) survival and proliferation. We propose an integrated mechanistic framework linking HIV-driven autophagy suppression to enhanced TB susceptibility, highlighting the synergistic interplay between HIV proteins and Mtb evasion strategies. By elucidating these molecular connections, we identify autophagy as a promising therapeutic target and highlight autophagy-directed host-directed therapies as a potential strategy to reduce the persistent TB burden in PLWH and advance toward a cure for both infections.

papers.title_en: Innate immunity and antibiotic activity in resistant bacterial infections in immunocompromised hosts.
papers.authors: Sun Y, Guo Y, Cui H, Jiang Y, Yu Q
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pharmacy, China-Japan Union Hospital of Jilin University, Changchun, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: We propose a research-oriented framework integrating antibacterial exposure, bacterial phenotype and burden, infection compartment, and host immune function to guide mechanistic investigation, while retaining effective antibiotic treatment and source control when indicated as the foundations of clinical care.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未说明文献检索策略、纳入标准或证据分级方法，属叙述性综述；对集落刺激因子、干扰素-γ、噬菌体-抗生素组合等佐剂仅定性描述'证据强度差异大'，未给出任何效应量、置信区间或推荐等级；'免疫功能影响抗生素暴露-反应关系'引自实验研究但摘要无具体数据；摘要通篇无数值结果。
papers.abstract_en: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is particularly difficult to manage in immunocompromised hosts, in whom impaired bacterial containment and clearance can coexist with restricted treatment options, altered drug exposure, and anatomically complex infection sites. Susceptibility testing and pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) assessment guide antibiotic treatment, while host defenses help determine whether injured bacteria are cleared. This Review examines the host-antibiotic interface in resistant bacterial infection, with emphasis on how innate immunity contributes to antibacterial activity in immunocompromised populations. We distinguish quantitative and qualitative defects in neutrophils, monocyte hyporesponsiveness, complement impairment, barrier disruption, and combined host deficits, and consider how bacterial burden, infection compartment, and protected intracellular or extracellular populations modify drug-host interactions. Experimental studies show that immune function influences bacterial growth, clearance, and observed antibiotic exposure-response relationships. Antibiotic-induced changes in bacterial morphology, microbial-product release, and immune recognition may promote clearance or inflammatory injury depending on pathogen, burden, timing, and host state. Adjunctive approaches, including colony-stimulating factors, interferon-γ, innate agonists, pathogen-specific antibodies, antibody-antibiotic conjugates, and phage-antibiotic combinations, vary substantially in mechanism and strength of supporting evidence. Clinical assessment of adjunctive strategies requires evidence of improved infection outcomes as well as biological activity. We propose a research-oriented framework integrating antibacterial exposure, bacterial phenotype and burden, infection compartment, and host immune function to guide mechanistic investigation, while retaining effective antibiotic treatment and source control when indicated as the foundations of clinical care.

papers.authors: Dong J, Li J, Yang Y, Wang K, Tian X, Zhu W, Wang T, Wang X et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: College of Chinese Medicine, Changchun University of Chinese Medicine, Changchun, Jilin, China; The Affiliated Hospital …

papers.ai_note: 信息不足：作者称“铁死亡靶向治疗未改善OSA-IPF临床结局”，但摘要未给出任何支持该表述的研究数据或出处；仅检索PubMed单一数据库，证据分级为主观定性、无定量合并或偏倚评估工具；联合IH-纤维化模型仅显示损伤加重而“未确立铁死亡介导”，却仍据此提出二次打击模型，属假说外推；人类OSA-IPF证据异质且为观察性，因果推断受限；检索截止日期标为2026年6月11日，与常规时间线存在异常，需核实。
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) frequently coexists with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). We examine ferroptosis as a possible mediator of chronic intermittent hypoxia (CIH)-associated progression of established fibrosis. METHODS: PubMed was searched through 11 June 2026 using a defined ferroptosis-fibrosis/sleep-apnea strategy and reference screening. Clinical and experimental evidence was classified qualitatively by model relevance and causal strength. FINDINGS: CIH may alter oxidative stress, iron handling, antioxidant defenses and lipid peroxidation. Experimental fibrosis studies implicate ferroptosis-related alveolar epithelial injury and iron-dependent fibroblast activation, while combined IH-fibrosis models demonstrate enhanced injury without establishing ferroptosis mediation. Human OSA-IPF findings are heterogeneous and observational. These observations collectively support a proposed "second-hit" model linking OSA-associated intermittent hypoxia to ferroptosis-related mechanisms in IPF progression. CONCLUSIONS: Ferroptosis is a plausible yet unconfirmed mechanism of CIH-associated fibrotic progression. Ferroptosis-targeted treatments have not improved clinical outcomes in OSA-IPF. Cell-specific factorial experiments and prospective cohorts are required.

papers.study_type: NHANES 2001-2018 跨周期横断面观察性研究（自报COPD，RCS剂量反应与敏感性分析）
papers.title_zh: 饮食总抗氧化能力与COPD患病几率呈非线性负相关：NHANES 2001-2018横断面分析
papers.title_en: Association between dietary total antioxidant capacity and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: findings from the national health and nutrition examination survey.
papers.authors: Tan H, Wang Y, Wu L
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, Suzhou Guangci Cancer Hospital, Suzhou, 215000, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: Higher dietary antioxidant capacity is associated with lower COPD risk in a nonlinear manner independent of smoking intensity, warranting further longitudinal research to confirm these findings.
papers.ai_note: COPD定义为自报医师诊断而非肺功能确认，存在结局误分类风险；横断面设计只能反映患病几率，作者结论用'lower COPD risk'表述因果方向，属人群限定与措辞松动；Q4 OR（0.78）弱于Q3（0.71）呈非单调，最高抗氧化暴露组保护效应反而减弱，作者未解释；'independent of smoking intensity'仅指统计学调整，残余混杂与反向因果（COPD患者饮食改变）无法排除；摘要未报告膳食TAC的具体计算方法与绝对摄入量
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: This study aimed to investigate the association between dietary total antioxidant capacity (TAC) and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) using data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES). METHODS: This cross-sectional study included participants aged ≥ 40 years from NHANES cycles 2001-2018. COPD was defined as a self-reported physician diagnosis. TAC was calculated from 24-hour dietary recall data and categorized into quartiles. Weighted multivariable logistic regression models were used adjusting for demographic, socioeconomic, behavioral, and clinical factors to assess the association between TAC quartiles and COPD. Restricted cubic spline (RCS) analysis was performed to explore the dose-response relationship, and subgroup analyses were conducted to evaluate effect modification. Inverse probability weighting and multiple imputation were used for sensitivity analyses. RESULTS: A total of 29,225 participants were included in the final analysis, of whom 2,829 (9.7%) had COPD. In the fully adjusted model (Model 3), higher TAC was associated with lower odds of COPD compared with the lowest quartile (Q1): Q2 (OR = 0.83, 95% CI: 0.66-1.02, P = 0.084), Q3 (OR = 0.71, 95% CI: 0.57-0.88, P = 0.003), and Q4 (OR = 0.78, 95% CI: 0.62-0.99, P = 0.040). RCS analysis demonstrated a significant nonlinear inverse dose-response relationship between dietary TAC and COPD risk (P for overall = 0.005; P for nonlinearity = 0.024). No significant effect modification was observed across any of the examined subgroups (all P for interaction > 0.05). Sensitivity analyses using inverse probability weighting and multiple imputation confirmed the robustness of the results. CONCLUSION: Higher dietary antioxidant capacity is associated with lower COPD risk in a nonlinear manner independent of smoking intensity, warranting further longitudinal research to confirm these findings. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

papers.title_en: Influence of genetic variants on the response to long-acting β2-agonists (LABAs) and long-acting muscarinic antagonists (LAMAs) and combination therapies in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD): a systematic review.
papers.authors: Torrecillas-Baena B, Puentes-Osorio Y, Ramírez V, Salamanca-Miñarro MA, García-Alcaide A, Pajuelo LSM
papers.affiliation_highlight: Duponte Investigación y Desarrollo S.L., Seville, Spain.
papers.authors_conclusion: This review highlights the latest advances in COPD pharmacogenetics by synthesizing available evidence on patient responses to bronchodilators and corticosteroids. By mapping key methodological factors, the review provides valuable insight into optimizing future research.
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告任何终点的具体效应量、CI或P值，仅定性描述关联与不一致；ADRB2变异对支气管扩张剂治疗反应的结果不一致，GWAS发现的候选变异未在后续独立分析中重复，SUMF1 rs793391证据基于有限数据且缺乏独立重复；因研究数量少与异质性大未行Meta分析，整体证据确定性低。信息不足：无法判断是否存在选择性强调，因摘要未给出数值化结果。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a heterogeneous respiratory disease in which patients may differ in terms of clinical course and response to drug treatment. Genetic variability may contribute to these differences by influencing drug response and clinical outcomes. This systematic review aimed to summarize the available evidence on the association between genetic variants and clinical outcomes or treatment response in patients with COPD receiving LABA- and/or LAMA-based therapies, as well as pharmacogenetic response to combination inhalants. METHODS: A systematic search was conducted in the PubMed and Scopus databases, as well as in the gray literature, for studies published between 2015 and 2026. Studies were considered eligible if they included adults with COPD receiving LABA and/or LAMA treatment, including combination regimens, and evaluated genetic variants in relation to therapeutic response. Additionally, studies focusing on disease phenotypes rather than specific pharmacogenetic markers were also included. Study selection and data extraction were performed by two independent reviewers. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS) and Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 (RoB 2) tool. RESULTS: A total of 51 records were identified, and eight studies were included. Genetic variants in the ADRB2, FAM13A, SUMF1, MAPK8, AZU1, CSE1L, and CCL2 genes were investigated in relation to lung function, disease severity, and treatment response. ADRB2 variants (rs1042713, rs1042714, and rs1800888) were associated with lung function and exacerbation risk, although results regarding bronchodilator treatment response were inconsistent. Regarding other genetic variants, SUMF1 rs793391 emerged as a candidate variant in patients treated with combined bronchodilators and inhaled corticosteroids (ICS). However, these findings are based on limited data and currently lack independent replication, warranting cautious interpretation. Furthermore, findings from large GWAS revealed novel candidates associated with treatment outcomes, though these results were not replicated in subsequent independent enome-Wide Association Study analyses. Due to the limited number of studies and considerable heterogeneity, no meta-analysis was performed. CONCLUSION: This review highlights the latest advances in COPD pharmacogenetics by synthesizing available evidence on patient responses to bronchodilators and corticosteroids. By mapping key methodological factors, the review provides valuable insight into optimizing future research. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: www.crd.york.ac.uk/prospero/, identifier CRD420261392469.

papers.authors: Blomberg R, Herrera JA, Noelle H, Mueller MC, McCabe MC, Schwartz DA, Magin CM
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Biomedical Engineering, University of Colorado, Denver | Anschutz, Aurora, CO, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: Together, these findings demonstrate region-specific and disease-associated sex differences in the human lung proteome and suggest that baseline sex differences in control lungs may contribute to sex-specific susceptibility, progression, and clinical outcomes in IPF, underscoring the importance of considering sex as a biological variable in future mechanistic and clinical studies of IPF.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告样本量、分组人数、统计检验方法、差异蛋白数量、效应量或校正后P值，无法评估差异的统计学强度与可重复性；研究为对既往数据集的二次再分析，无独立验证队列；结论中'contribute to ... clinical outcomes'涉及临床结局，但本研究并未纳入生存或临床终点数据，属机制外推；背景所述IPF约70%为男性属流行病学引用，非本研究结果。
papers.abstract_en: Biological sex has systemic effects on gene expression, cell behavior, and disease pathobiology. Despite these widespread effects, sex as a biological variable remains understudied, particularly in chronic lung diseases. In idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), approximately 70% of patients are male, and male patients have overall worse survival following diagnosis. While behavioral differences between sexes might account for some of the epidemiological differences, the contribution of underlying biology is not known. In this study, we re-analyzed a previously generated regional proteomic dataset obtained by laser capture microdissection coupled with mass spectrometry to identify sex-associated differences in protein abundance. We discovered that even in control lungs, sex differences existed in both airway and alveolar regions. Sex differences became more pronounced in diseased regions of IPF lungs, with sex-biased abundance of diverse proteins including those associated with extracellular vesicle secretion, cellular metabolism, and extracellular matrix remodeling. Together, these findings demonstrate region-specific and disease-associated sex differences in the human lung proteome and suggest that baseline sex differences in control lungs may contribute to sex-specific susceptibility, progression, and clinical outcomes in IPF, underscoring the importance of considering sex as a biological variable in future mechanistic and clinical studies of IPF.

papers.abstract_en: The role of the microbiome in disease pathogenesis is an emerging field with strong evidence suggesting that dysbiosis is associated with precancerous and cancerous states. Microbiome data present substantial challenges for causal mediation analysis due to sparsity, compositional constraints, and latent heterogeneity. To address these issues, we propose a zero-inflated beta mixture (ZIBM) method for mediation analysis with compositional microbiome mediators. The proposed method accommodates excess zeros through a zero-inflation component and captures heterogeneity in non-zero relative abundances using a beta mixture distribution. Within the potential-outcomes framework, the ZIBM provides estimates of marginal microbiome-mediated causal effects, and model parameters are estimated using an expectation-maximization algorithm. Simulation studies demonstrate that the ZIBM yields more accurate estimation and reliable inference under conditions commonly observed in microbiome data, compared with existing approaches. An application to a real microbiome study further illustrates its practical utility. These results indicate that the proposed method provides a more flexible and robust statistical framework for mediation analysis involving compositional microbiome data.

papers.abstract_en: RATIONALE: Pulmonary ionocytes, representing approximately 1% of airway epithelial cells, exhibit high CFTR expression and unique transcriptional markers, including FOXI1, ASCL3, and V-ATPase. Their exact role in human airway physiology is incompletely understood. OBJECTIVE: This study employs induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived airway epithelial models (iPSC-airways) to elucidate the role of FOXI1 in pulmonary ionocyte differentiation and function. METHODS: CRISPR-Cas9 was used to generate FOXI1-knockout iPSCs, into which a doxycycline-inducible FOXI1-overexpression cassette was introduced. Edited and control lines were differentiated into airway epithelia to evaluate ionocyte formation, epithelial composition, and ion transport. Rescue studies assessed the effects of FOXI1 re-expression in a FOXI1-KO background, and the addition of inducible WT-CFTR ionocytes to F508del/F508del cystic fibrosis (CF) cultures on restoring chloride transport. MEASUREMENTS AND MAIN RESULTS: FOXI1 deletion abolishes ionocyte formation and alters airway epithelial composition, with increased mucus-secreting goblet cells and decreased ciliated cells. Functional assays confirmed ionocytes as key regulators of chloride homeostasis, with FOXI1-deficient airways displaying diminished ion transport. Induction of FOXI1-overexpression restored CFTR-mediated chloride transport. Introduction of WT ionocytes into CF airway models rescued chloride transport deficits, with no rescue observed in vehicle-treated controls lacking ionocyte induction. CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight FOXI1's essential role in pulmonary ionocyte development, airway cell composition, and airway chloride transport. We present a fully manipulable, gene-edited iPSC-derived system that enables investigation of ionocyte biology and function within a human airway context, highlighting them as promising therapeutic targets for respiratory disorders.

papers.title_en: Multi-source COVID-19 surveillance in Fujian, China: epidemiological features of two epidemic waves and public health implications.
papers.authors: Lin J, Zheng S, Zhang Z, Cai J, Chen C, Lin Y, Ou J, Zhu H et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Fujian Center for Disease Control and Prevention, Fujian Provincial Key Laboratory of Zoonosis Research, Fuzhou, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: 观察到的两次疫情高峰间隔约5个月，多源监测指标时间一致性高；但滞后交叉相关显示指标基本同步移动，因此哨点监测应被视为补充性监测工具，而非已证实的早期预警措施；XBB变异株在本次疫情中于本地首次检出后约4周达到占优，这是描述性观察，不能推广为经验证的预测工具；这些发现有助于多波疫情准备与监测改进。
papers.ai_note: 摘要已自行承认核酸检测量与监测条件改变使跨波峰值比较不可靠，10.7–99.9%的降幅区间极宽、异质性大，不宜作疗效性解读。哨点监测的早期预警假设为阴性结果（滞后交叉相关显示同步而非领先），作者结论口径与之一致，但研究属生态学时序相关，无法排除指标同步受共同外部驱动（政策、就诊行为）影响；无个体层级数据、无混杂控制，属方法学局限。信息不足：各指标绝对数值、样本量与变异株检测覆盖面。
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Using Fujian's multi-source Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) surveillance system, this study compared epidemiological features and indicator associations of two successive epidemic waves to optimize epidemic surveillance and prevention strategies. METHODS: Multi-source surveillance data were collected from week 49 of 2022 (the week of December 7, 2022, when the 10 optimization measures were issued) to week 29 of 2023 (July 17-23, 2023) in Fujian Province, including reported COVID-19 cases, fever clinic visits, population nucleic acid testing, sentinel hospital surveillance, hospitalized severe cases, and viral variants. Descriptive epidemiology, Spearman correlation, and lagged cross-correlation analyses were adopted for data evaluation. RESULTS: The first wave showed a sharp peak pattern, with most indicators peaking around weeks 51-52/2022 and reported cases peaking at week 1/2023; the second wave exhibited a gradual peak at week 21/2023. Peak levels of the second wave were 10.7-99.9% lower across indicators, although the markedly reduced nucleic acid testing volume and changed surveillance conditions warrant cautious interpretation of cross-wave comparisons. The interval between the two epidemic peaks was about 5 months, and severe cases consistently lagged infection peaks by approximately 2 weeks. Indicators were strongly correlated, with the highest correlation between sentinel and nucleic acid positivity rates (rs = 0.92, p < 0.001); lagged cross-correlation analysis indicated that these two indicators moved essentially in synchrony. The XBB variant took approximately 4 weeks from initial local detection to predominance alongside the second epidemic peak. CONCLUSION: The two observed epidemic peaks were approximately 5 months apart, and multi-source surveillance indicators showed high temporal concordance. However, lagged cross-correlation indicated that the indicators moved essentially in synchrony, so sentinel surveillance should be regarded as a complementary monitoring tool rather than a proven early-warning measure. The XBB variant reached predominance approximately 4 weeks after initial local detection in this episode, a descriptive observation that cannot be generalized as a validated predictive tool. These findings facilitate multi-wave epidemic preparedness and surveillance improvement.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Co-infection can accelerate the progression of SFTS, this study aims to analyze the clinical characteristics of SFTS-associated co-infection and identify the associated risk factors. METHODS: In this retrospective study, we analyzed epidemiology, pathogen distribution patterns, and laboratory findings between community-acquired infections (CAIs) and hospital-acquired infections (HAIs) in SFTS patients. Our objectives were to determine the prevalence, characterize clinical manifestations, and identify potential risk factors associated with SFTS co-infection. RESULTS: Among 231 SFTS patients, 81 (35.1%) had co-infection. SFTS patients with CAIs exhibited the highest mortality rate (23.4%). Compared to those without co-infection, patients with CAIs had more severe clinical presentation and poorer outcome. Antifungal treatment significantly improved survival in SFTS with CAIs-related fungal infections, but had no benefit in those with HAIs-related fungal infections. Pulmonary infections were associated with reduced survival time in SFTS patients with HAIs but had no significant impact on those with CAIs. Multivariate logistic regression analysis identified several independent risk factors for CAIs in SFTS patients, including diarrhea, cerebral infarction, antifungal therapy, ICU admission, elevated D-Dimer levels, and A/G <1.05. Among SFTS patients with co-infection, A/G <1.05 demonstrated potential predictive value for CAIs (AUC = 0.714, 95% CI: 0.626-0.832). Further analysis revealed that an A/G ratio <1.05 indicated moderate discriminatory performance for SFTS patients with CAIs related pulmonary fungal infections (AUC = 0.799, 95% CI: 0.702-0.896). CONCLUSIONS: SFTS patients with CAIs had poorer clinical outcomes than patients without co-infection or those with HAIs. An A/G ratio <1.05 may serve as a supportive marker for identifying patients at increased risk of CAIs and could assist clinical risk stratification.

papers.ai_note: 关联强度仅在多重插补模型中勉强显著，完整病例分析（P=0.0588）与样条总体检验（P=0.0557）均为阴性，结论依赖单一插补策略；OR约1.019/单位，单位刻度未说明（是否每单位或每对数增量信息不足），临床效应量难评估。增量AUC的bootstrap区间跨0（-0.0006至0.0351），且SIRI判别力显著劣于NLR，研究实质是对SIRI作为新标志物的证伪性结果。单中心、回顾性、复合终点（仅报告含4例死亡的构成，各组分定义与权重信息不足）、事件数有限，存在人群与外推局限。
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: To assess the association between the systemic inflammation response index (SIRI) at admission and 14-day adverse clinical outcomes in patients with pyogenic liver abscess (PLA), and to evaluate its discriminatory performance. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort study included 670 adults with PLA admitted to Linyi People's Hospital between January 2021 and December 2024. SIRI was calculated from the first complete blood count obtained within 24 hours after admission according to the study data-collection criteria. The primary outcome was a composite of adverse clinical events within 14 days. A base logistic regression model and a model additionally including SIRI were fitted in 30 multiply imputed datasets, with complete-case and death-exclusion sensitivity analyses. Restricted cubic splines, receiver operating characteristic curves, and exploratory measures of incremental performance were evaluated. RESULTS: Of the 670 patients, 100 (14.9%) experienced an adverse clinical outcome, including four deaths. Median SIRI was higher in patients with adverse outcomes [8.95 (4.14-15.64) vs. 5.80 (2.93-11.64); P< 0.001]. In the multiply imputed linear model, the adjusted OR for SIRI was 1.0187 (95% CI, 1.0022-1.0354; P = 0.0262); the complete-case estimate was 1.0163 (95% CI, 0.9994-1.0334; P = 0.0588). After exclusion of four deaths, the adjusted OR was 1.0191 (95% CI, 1.0026-1.0360; P = 0.0233) among 666 patients with 96 nonfatal adverse outcomes. The spline overall association and nonlinearity P values were 0.0557 and 0.4080, respectively. The AUC for SIRI was 0.6072, lower than that for NLR (0.6782; paired DeLong P = 0.0015). Adding SIRI increased the apparent model AUC by 0.0116 (95% bootstrap interval, -0.0006 to 0.0351). CONCLUSION: Higher admission SIRI was associated with greater odds of 14-day adverse clinical outcomes in the multiply imputed linear model, but its standalone discrimination was limited. Sensitivity analyses and incremental performance estimates indicate uncertainty, and clinical utility requires further validation.

papers.authors: Javaheri S, Eshgabaidi A, Aboelnasr A, Forgo V
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Pulmonary and Sleep Medicine, Bethesda North Hospital, Cincinnati, OH, USA; Division of Cardiology, The Ohio…
papers.authors_conclusion: 尽管呼吸安全性更好，本初步研究首次提供了慢性使用丁丙诺啡与两种不同模式的临床显著睡眠障碍相关的证据，这两种模式与其他阿片类药物共有；这些呼吸紊乱事件可能是文献中报道的丁丙诺啡相关死亡的潜在原因，这一发现同样见于其他阿片类药物；临床医生应意识到这一关联。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Individuals on opioids are found dead in bed and respiratory depression is a potential cause. In contrast to other opioids, buprenorphine, a partial μ-opioid receptor agonist has reduced respiratory depression. However, death has also been reported in individuals using buprenorphine; yet, it is not known if chronic use of buprenorphine could be associated with clinically significant respiratory depression. OBJECTIVE: The purpose of this preliminary study was to determine if chronic buprenorphine use is associated with sleep disordered breathing. METHODS: A retrospective study of 11 consecutive patients who were using buprenorphine chronically and referred for sleep evaluation. All underwent full night attended polysomnography and polysomnograms were scored page by page by a board-certified sleep physician. RESULTS: Two breathing patterns were observed. First, four patients had central sleep apnea (CSA) with an index of ≥5/h of sleep and an average of 13. When compared to those without CSA, patients with CSA suffered from severe sleep apnea with an apnea hypopnea index (AHI) of 35 (vs.9/hour of sleep) and associated with clinically significant low saturation (75% vs. 87%). Second, the group without significant CSA (CAI <5, n = 7), despite a low AHI, had relatively more sustained desaturation time below 90% (91 vs 51 min), suggesting hypoventilation. CONCLUSIONS: Despite improved respiratory safety profile, this preliminary study is the first to provide evidence that chronic use of buprenorphine is associated with clinically significant sleep disorders with two distinct patterns shared with other opioids. These disordered breathing events could be a potential cause of buprenorphine-associated death reported in the literature, a finding also shared with other opioids. Clinicians should be aware of this association.

papers.authors: Benedetti G, Bonfanti P, De Coppi P, Giobbe GG
papers.affiliation_highlight: Stem Cells and Regenerative Medicine Section, Developmental Biology and Cancer, Great Ormond Street Institute of Child H…
papers.authors_conclusion: We established a robust and reproducible protocol for generating and maintaining oesophageal organoids across culture formats. These models retained epithelial features while exhibiting culture-dependent differentiation. This platform enables complementary 2D and 3D investigation of oesophageal epithelial biology and supports future comparison of healthy and disease-derived tissues for patient-specific modelling and mechanistic studies.
papers.ai_note: 摘要为定性描述，无样本量、供体数量、传代次数上限、定量表达数据或统计检验，信息不足，无法评估'长期传代''稳健可重复'等主张；未提供与已有食管类器官方案的比较或疾病组织验证；主要终点（长期维持与表征）缺乏量化指标；样本来自内镜活检与手术切除两类来源，但未说明构成比例与是否含病理组织。
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Human patient-derived oesophageal epithelial models are limited, and organoid cultures often have short passaging lifespans, restricting studies of tissue homeostasis and disease. We aimed to establish and characterise primary oesophageal organoids from non-pathologic epithelium as a renewable epithelial source and adaptable modelling platform. METHODS: Primary oesophageal tissues were obtained from endoscopic biopsies and surgical resections. Basal epithelial cells were isolated and cultured under optimised conditions to establish long-term three-dimensional organoids. Organoid-derived cells were expanded as two-dimensional monolayers and re-seeded into 3D culture. Epithelial identity and differentiation were assessed by immunostaining and RT-qPCR (reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction) analysis of markers. RESULTS: Primary organoids were established and maintained while preserving epithelial markers. Expression of KRT14, involucrin, loricrin and filaggrin confirmed the oesophageal phenotype. Larger, multilayered primary organoids showed increased expression of differentiation-associated markers relative to 2D monolayers and re-seeded small organoids, indicating culture configuration influences epithelial differentiation while maintaining lineage identity. CONCLUSIONS: We established a robust and reproducible protocol for generating and maintaining oesophageal organoids across culture formats. These models retained epithelial features while exhibiting culture-dependent differentiation. This platform enables complementary 2D and 3D investigation of oesophageal epithelial biology and supports future comparison of healthy and disease-derived tissues for patient-specific modelling and mechanistic studies.

The results should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating due to the limited subgroup sample sizes. Larger studies incorporating metagenomic and metabolomic approaches are needed to validate these observations and clarify their potential clinical relevance.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Post-COVID Condition (PCC) is a heterogeneous clinical syndrome in which chronic fatigue and functional limitation are among the most disabling manifestations. Alterations in the gut microbiota have been proposed as contributors to PCC pathophysiology; however, it remains unclear whether distinct clinical PCC phenotypes are associated with specific microbiota signatures. RESULTS: This cross-sectional pilot study analysed gut microbiota composition and predicted functional capacity in 50 participants from Aragón (Spain), including 30 patients with PCC and 20 healthy controls. PCC patients were stratified according to the presence of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS)-like symptoms and functional limitation assessed using the 6-Minute Walking Test. Alpha and beta diversity did not differ significantly between groups (Figs. 2 and 3). Differential abundance analysis identified taxon-level differences between groups. Escherichia/Shigella was enriched in PCC-CFS relative to controls, both overall and in the subgroup without functional limitation, representing the most consistent signal. Additional differences included higher Streptococcus and Veillonella in controls, and higher Flavonifractor and Hungatella in PCC-NCFS. After adjustment for digestive symptoms and vaccine dose, these associations attenuated and none remained significant, indicating that they may be partly driven by confounding.PICRUSt2 functional predictions suggested differences in pathways related to nucleotide and amino acid metabolism; however, none remained significant after correction for multiple testing and should therefore be considered exploratory. CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest the presence of phenotype-associated taxonomic differences within PCC despite the absence of global diversity alterations. The results should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating due to the limited subgroup sample sizes. Larger studies incorporating metagenomic and metabolomic approaches are needed to validate these observations and clarify their potential clinical relevance.

papers.abstract_en: Stage II to III NSCLC management is an evolving field with several multimodal treatment strategies. Management decisions are dictated by disease stage, resectability, biomarker testing, and resource availability, along with patient factors and preferences. To optimize outcomes for patients with stage II to III NSCLC, early and accurate diagnosis and staging, molecular alteration assessment, and evaluation of resectability and operability are essential to support a personalized treatment approach. To best facilitate comprehensive NSCLC care, a multidisciplinary team (MDT) composed of different healthcare specialists is critical. Here, we review MDT care in stage II to III NSCLC management and the benefits it provides to patients, including accurate staging, compliance with molecular testing, reduced time to treatment initiation, greater adherence to treatment guidelines, enhanced health system efficiencies, and ultimately improved outcomes. Despite these benefits, many patients do not have access to MDT care, or it is not well implemented. We review the barriers to MDT care, ranging from limited access to diagnostic technologies and specialists, costs, best practices and incentives, clinical pathway limitations, and racial and socioeconomic disparities, and provide recommendations to address these barriers. These include the development of regional MDTs and triage systems, along with incentivizing MDT care and standardizing best practices and workflows. We further discuss advances in stage II to III NSCLC, including the continuing evolution of diagnostics, treatment strategies, and artificial intelligence-based management algorithms, where MDTs must be able to adapt to incorporate these innovations.

papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Anatomy and Physiology, University of Melbourne, Melbourne, VIC, Australia.
papers.authors_conclusion: We introduce the Neuroanatomic Diagnostic Protocol and the rationale behind it, a proposed timely and practical update to the classic framework that unifies the known association of cough with common etiological causes, the existence of refractory chronic cough, and the core concepts of cough hypersensitivity syndrome by acknowledging the vagus nerve and its central circuits as a distinct anatomical consideration in the effective assessment and targeted management of chronic cough.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic cough represents a challenging clinical problem and significant unmet global burden. For some patients, cough can be associated with conditions impacting the respiratory system, including asthma, rhinosinusitis, and gastroesophageal reflux disease. This underpinned the rationale for the development of the Anatomic Diagnostic Protocol, an etiology-based algorithm for chronic cough management used in clinical practice for over 50 years. However, despite the value of the Anatomic Diagnostic Protocol, many patients do not respond adequately to the clinical strategies promoted in the existing management framework because they either have no obvious causative disease or their cough is unresolved by standard etiology-based therapies (refractory chronic cough). This, along with the introduction of cough hypersensitivity syndrome as a unifying condition common to most patients with chronic cough, has added additional complexity for physicians in everyday practice. FINDINGS: We introduce the Neuroanatomic Diagnostic Protocol and the rationale behind it, a proposed timely and practical update to the classic framework that unifies the known association of cough with common etiological causes, the existence of refractory chronic cough, and the core concepts of cough hypersensitivity syndrome by acknowledging the vagus nerve and its central circuits as a distinct anatomical consideration in the effective assessment and targeted management of chronic cough.

papers.abstract_en: This study aimed to characterize and compare methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) strains isolated from community members and healthcare workers (HCWs) in Egypt using antibiotic susceptibility testing, mecA gene detection, SCCmec typing, and ERIC-PCR fingerprinting. A cross-sectional study was conducted between September 2024 and January 2025, during which 450 specimens were collected from Mansoura University Hospitals and the local community, where 71 specimens (30.8%) were confirmed as MRSA. MRSA prevalence was significantly higher among HCWs, 62.5% (50/80), than among community members, 14% (21/150). In general, antibiotic resistance rates were higher in HCW strains. All isolates were resistant to cefoxitin and sensitive to vancomycin.The methicillin-resistant phenotype of the 71 MRSA isolates was confirmed by positive mecA gene tests, with SCCmec Type III prevalent among healthcare workers and SCCmec Type IV predominating in the community. ERIC-PCR fingerprinting demonstrated the isolates' genetic diversity. The dendrogram based on ERIC patterns showed distinct clusters between community and hospital strains, though with some overlap, suggesting possible transmission between the two populations.In conclusion, MRSA strains from HCWs displayed broader antibiotic resistance and greater clonal similarity, while community strains were more diverse and less resistant. The presence of intermixed clusters between community-acquired (CA-MRSA) and (HCW-MRSA) suggested a possible bidirectional transmission pathway, underscoring the blurring of epidemiological boundaries.These results underline the necessity of ongoing molecular surveillance and integrated infection control strategies to track the spread of MRSA in community and clinical settings.

papers.abstract_en: Halophilic archaea are a distinct domain of life, separate from Bacteria and Eukarya, that thrive in highly saline environments, including salt mines. Their impact on the human immune system is poorly known. The respiratory epithelium is the first line of defence against inhaled environmental agents, including pollutants, allergens and microorganisms. Disruption of epithelial barrier integrity is linked to the pathogenesis of allergic and inflammatory airway diseases. In this study we examined the interaction of Halorhabdus rudnickae WSM-64T, isolated from the Barycz area of the Wieliczka Salt-Mine in Poland with the human bronchial epithelial cell line Calu-3. We found that this halophilic archaeal strain did not cause cytotoxic or genotoxic effects on Calu-3 cells and significantly enhanced the healing process of physically damaged monolayers of cells compared to unstimulated cells. Moreover, halophilic archaeal stimulation of Calu-3 was associated with significantly increased fluorescence intensity of ZO-1, scaffolding protein responsible for organizing the junctional proteins and stabilising cell barriers. Exposure to Hrd. rudnickae significantly decreased the secretion of TGF-beta by Calu-3 cells, suggesting a potential ability to counteract the pathological changes driven by TGF-beta. In the air-liquid interface model we observed significant reduction in FITC-dextran permeability, indicating improved barrier integrity after stimulation of Calu-3 with halophilic archaea. Our findings thus show that halophilic archaeon Hrd. rudnickae isolated from a Polish salt mine can induce the enhancement of epithelial barrier integrity in the Calu-3 cells, providing a conceptual framework for future immunomodulatory strategies in patients with pulmonary allergic disorders.

papers.authors: Xu B, Wang Z, Chai J, Wei Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Faculty of Life Science and Technology, Kunming University of Science and Technology, Kunming, 650500, China.

papers.abstract_en: Staphylococcus aureus(S. aureus)is an important foodborne pathogen. Host-derived catecholamines released under stress are known to influence bacterial pathogenic processes, including growth, virulence, biofilm formation. However, the role of dopamine in this context remains less well understood, particularly in S. aureus. In this study, we investigated the effects of dopamine on S. aureus ATCC 25,923 using a combination of phenotypic assays and multi-omics analyses. Dopamine was taken up by the bacteria and was associated with enhanced pathogenic phenotypes, including increased proliferation, toxin production, biofilm formation, motility, adhesion, and multidrug resistance. In a mouse infection experiment, dopamine treatment further increased bacterial colonization and organ invasion. Mechanistically, multi-omics analyses indicated that dopamine activates the SaeRS two-component system and is associated with the upregulation of virulence-related factors, adhesion-associated proteins, and membrane lipid synthesis pathways, along with increased activity in key metabolic processes such as the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle and oxidative phosphorylation. Importantly, deletion of saeS markedly attenuated these dopamine-associated effects. Taken together, these findings suggest that dopamine likely influences S. aureus pathogenicity primarily through the SaeRS signaling pathway and provide insight into how host stress signals may contribute to bacterial infection.

papers.affiliation_highlight: State Key Laboratory of Integration and Innovation of Classic Formula and Modern Chinese Medicine, National Chinmedomics…
papers.authors_conclusion: Collectively, our findings indicate that JF mitigates urticaria-like inflammation, likely through gut microbiota and modulating SCFA, bile acid, tryptophan, and lipid metabolism. This multi-omics evidence suggests that JF may act through the gut microbiota-metabolite-skin signaling axis to confer anti-urticarial benefits. Nevertheless, further causal validation experiments and clinical investigations are warranted.
papers.ai_note: 摘要通篇为方向性描述，未报告任何效应量、P值或置信区间，也未给样本量、随机化与盲法信息，信息不足无法评估统计学稳健性；核心证据为Spearman相关性而非因果干预（作者亦承认需因果验证），存在把相关当机制的倾向；结论中likely/may措辞与标题's alleviates'的确定性口径不一致；与胸科/胸部肿瘤业务无直接关联。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The systemic and relapsing nature of urticaria cannot be fully explained by cutaneous mast-cell activation alone. Whether the gut contributes, and whether a multi-component formula such as Jingfang Mixture (JF) acts through a gut-skin route, have not been tested together at the level of microbiota, metabolites, and skin signaling together. METHODS: Using an OVA (ovalbumin)/Al(OH)3-induced urticaria-like allergic inflammation rat model, we integrated 16S rRNA gene sequencing, fecal untargeted metabolomics, and skin DIA (data-independent acquisition)-based quantitative proteomics to investigate the therapeutic mechanisms of JF. RESULTS: JF suppressed both Th2 (IgE (immunoglobulin E), IL-4 (interleukin-4)) and Th17/pro-inflammatory (IL-6 (interleukin-6), TNF-α (tumor necrosis factor-α), IL-17 (interleukin-17)) responses, improved intestinal barrier-associated abnormalities, and partially reversed gut dysbiosis by restoring SCFA-producing bacteria (Bacteroidia, Clostridia, Lachnospirales, Oscillospirales) while reducing Proteobacteria and Enterobacterales. JF normalized the fecal metabolome, elevating anti-inflammatory metabolites including butyrate, indole, indole-3-acetic acid, docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) and reducing pro-inflammatory mediators such as arachidonic acid, leukotriene B4, secondary bile acids. At the skin level, JF activated AMPK (AMP-activated protein kinase) signaling and suppressed aberrant p38 MAPK (p38 mitogen-activated protein kinase) and PI3K (phosphoinositide 3-kinase)-Akt (protein kinase B) activation. Spearman correlation analysis further revealed that SCFAs (short-chain fatty acids) and indole derivatives were positively correlated with the abundance of AMPK-pathway-related proteins and negatively with p38 MAPK and PI3K-Akt proteins, whereas pro-inflammatory metabolites exhibited inverse correlation patterns. CONCLUSION: Collectively, our findings indicate that JF mitigates urticaria-like inflammation, likely through gut microbiota and modulating SCFA, bile acid, tryptophan, and lipid metabolism. This multi-omics evidence suggests that JF may act through the gut microbiota-metabolite-skin signaling axis to confer anti-urticarial benefits. Nevertheless, further causal validation experiments and clinical investigations are warranted.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUNDS: Hyperuricemia (HUA) has become a global health issue due to its rapidly increasing prevalence. Growing evidence from population and animal studies suggests that gut microbial dysbiosis and lifestyle changes are involved in serum uric acid metabolism. However, most existing studies are limited by small sample sizes or have yielded inconsistent findings. This study aimed to jointly investigate the associations of the gut microbiome, lifestyles, and dietary habits with HUA in Chinese elderly adults. METHODS: A community-based case-control study was conducted across nine provincial-level regions in China, involving 617 participants. Data collection included lifestyle and dietary habit questionnaires, chronic disease history, serum uric acid (sUA) measurement, and 16S rRNA sequencing of fecal samples. RESULTS: Taxonomic composition and diversity analyses revealed significant difference between the HUA and controls in gut microbiota structure and diversity. Through differential abundance and co-occurrence network analyses, 42 microbial signatures associated with HUA or sUA were identified. Notably, the prevalence of g_Stenotrophomonas was positively associated with short sleep duration. A microbial risk score (MRS) model constructed using these signatures demonstrated an area under curve (AUC) of 0.761 in the discovery cohort and 0.675 in the validation cohort. Furthermore, a significant positive association was observed between sleep quality (sleep duration, number of awakenings, and short sleep duration) and the MRS model. CONCLUSIONS: These results add to the accumulating evidence implicating the role of gut microbiota and sleep in HUA, such as g_Stenotrophomonas, and inform the potential effect of the microbiome-based association between sleep duration and HUA. However, due to the cross-sectional design, we cannot infer causality from these associations, and the observed findings should be confirmed in prospective studies.

papers.title_en: Recurrent pulmonary infection, a vicious cycle of multifactorial interactions, and prevention/treatment strategies.
papers.authors: Shen C, Li Y, Xiang Z, Zhao M, Wang J, Wang X
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pharmacy, Jiaxing Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: Existing evidence suggests that the clinical benefits of these interventions in RPI remain to be validated by more high-quality studies. The aim of this article is to provide a reference for the clinical management of RPI and to inform future research directions.
